game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Mill Stream, a stream-side windmill: the baker's apprentice must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Inventory Slots: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against thieves.
theme: The Kingdom – Mill Stream: a stream-side windmill
core_gameplay_loop: In Mill Stream, repeat each round: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against thieves. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the potion value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the royal vault using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The royal vault reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the royal vault is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Inventory Slots
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Inventory Slots' (Week 1 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mill Stream'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potion changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Mill Stream.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The royal vault reached with actions_used <= 10.
